setting: An alien civilization waged war through time itself; whether it survives is genuinely undecided — the conflict is still resolving. Its artifacts arrive out of sequence (effects before causes, relics that remember a future). Humans re-SEQUENCE the finds, and each new piece can retro-edit the meaning of everything collected so far. A causality puzzle, not a dig.

civs.name: the-erevan
civs.trait: fights from a future toward its own past; its fate is alive-or-dead undecided

civs.name: the-undated
civs.trait: an enemy that edits the war's earlier moves after they have already happened

civs.name: the-oncewill
civs.trait: neutral observers who remember outcomes that have not occurred yet

climax_label: the war that has not finished happening
